etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English recoveree, from Old French recovree, from recovrer (“recover”).

definitions.definition: The act or process of regaining or repossession of something lost.
The act of regaining the natural position after curtseying.
The act of regaining the position of guard after making an attack, in fencing, sparring, etc.
A return to former status or position.

quote.citation: 2022 January 12, “Network News: Further extension to Transport for London emergency funding”, in RAIL, number 948, page 8:
quote.text: Byford said: "There is no UK recovery from the pandemic without a London recovery, and there is no London recovery without a properly funded transport network.

definitions.definition: (law) A verdict giving somebody the right to recover debts or costs.
(mining) The extraction of an ore from a mine, or of a metal from an ore
(gaming) The ability to recover or regain health.
